name: Mortal Kombat X — Story Mode
notes: Primary in-game Mortal Kombat X Story Mode footage accessed through a third-party gameplay upload; the uploader is preservation/access infrastructure rather than canonical authority. Chapter 1 shows Netherrealm forces attacking Earthrealm, Raiden and Fujin defending the Sky Temple/Jinsei, Shinnok confronting them, Johnny Cage manifesting green defensive power when Shinnok attacks Sonya, and Raiden imprisoning Shinnok in his own amulet. The early post-imprisonment sequence then shows Earthrealm forces confront Quan Chi in the Netherrealm, Quan Chi begin a revenant-creation spell on a mortally wounded Johnny, Raiden counter the spell, Sonya defeat Quan Chi when he interferes, and Raiden complete the reversal that saves Johnny and restores Jax, Scorpion/Hanzo Hasashi, and Sub-Zero/Kuai Liang.
